title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2610.20576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. translated_title: 一个任务，多种界面：简单的跨界面一致性训练提升LLM智能体的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 后训练将LLM智能体的能力与其训练时所用的界面绑定在一起。对该界面进行保持语义的扰动，例如重命名某个动作或改变记号方式，虽然不会改变底层任务本身，却会使智能体的表现变差。由于对每个样本独立评分，界面随机化只会将这种依赖从单一界面扩大到训练界面的分布上，因此分布外的扰动仍会导致智能体性能下降。我们提出了跨界面策略正则化（CIPR），这是一种自监督目标函数，它用无信息的标识符替换动作名称，并在两个界面下呈现每个训练样本，在这两个界面中，等价的动作在构造上即可被对应识别。CIPR惩罚在两个界面下所诱导的动作分布之间的KL散度，从而使策略在不同界面之间保持行为一致。我们在监督学习和强化学习两种设置下评估了CIPR的效果。
tldr: 提出跨界面策略正则化（CIPR）这一自监督方法，通过在两个界面下惩罚动作分布间的KL散度，使LLM智能体在面对界面扰动（如动作重命名、记号变化）时保持一致行为，显著提升其跨界面的鲁棒性。
